company_desc1: We met in 2023 while studying film at Borgarholtsskóli and have worked closely together on a wide variety of film projects ever since. Over the years, we have taken part in numerous short film projects, giving us the opportunity to experience different aspects of filmmaking, from developing ideas and writing scripts to production, filming, and post-production.
company_desc2: With every project, we have gained more experience and developed a strong working relationship. Having worked together extensively, we know each other's strengths well and are used to solving problems that arise on set efficiently and calmly. To us, good film production is not only about getting the project across the finish line, but also about creating a positive and professional working environment where everyone involved can do their job under the best possible conditions.
company_desc3: During this time, we have built a strong network within the Icelandic film industry. We have worked with many actors and filmmakers on set and, through previous projects, have built trusted working relationships. This allows us to staff projects according to their needs and find the right people for each role, whether that means actors, technicians, assistants, or other specialized crew members.
company_desc4: Projects we have worked on have been screened at film festivals and received awards, giving us even more motivation to continue developing our skills and take on larger and more ambitious projects.
company_desc5: Our goal is to build a production company that people can trust with their ideas. Whether it is a short film, advertisement, music video, promotional content, or another film-related project, we want to work closely with our clients from the initial idea to the finished product. We believe that a positive atmosphere on set directly leads to better collaboration, more efficient work, and ultimately a better result.
